name: prof-openloop-ramp180
description: Hold-ratchet discriminator, take 2: step the OpenLoop velocity 30->180 rad/s el in 30 rad/s increments (0.6 s apart, small enough for the rotor to re-catch at 0.5 A) so the rotor is GENUINELY spinning at 180 with no startup machinery and no confirm probes, then hold ~4 s. Watch the 2 Hz 'obs:' trace: continuous ratchet here = lambda-tracker/clamp/R-mismatch class; stable tracking = the probes pump it.
